description: This file implements Diffie-Hellman key exchange and cryptographic key derivation functions using OpenSSL, including serialization/deserialization of keys, key generation, and secret derivation, with specific support for Netflix's authenticated Diffie-Hellman process.

classes.name: KeyStore
classes.description: Handles serialization, deserialization, and storage of cryptographic keys, including Diffie-Hellman and BIGNUM keys, interfacing with a Vault.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a BIGNUM or DH key into a vault storage, with options for exportability.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a key from the vault into BIGNUM or DH structures.

methods.name: GenerateDiffieHellmanKeys
methods.description: Generates Diffie-Hellman key pair with specified generator and modulus, and stores keys in vault.

methods.name: DiffieHellmanDeriveSecret
methods.description: Computes shared secret from private and peer public keys.

methods.name: DiffieHellmanDeriveSecret (overload)
methods.description: Derives shared secret from stored private and peer public key IDs, storing the result.

methods.name: DiffieHellmanAuthenticatedDeriveSecret
methods.description: Performs an authenticated Diffie-Hellman key derivation, producing encryption, HMAC, and wrapping keys for Netflix.
